require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'fiddle'
require 'fiddle/import'
require 'securerandom'

module NativeInference
  extend Fiddle::Importer
  dlload './libinference.so'
  extern 'int predict(const char*, int, char*, int)'
  extern 'int load_model(const char*)'
  extern 'void cleanup()'
end

class AuthTokenVerifier
  HMAC_ALGORITHM = 'sha256'
  EXPECTED_ALG = 'HS256'

  def initialize(shared_secret)
    @shared_secret = shared_secret
    @nonce_cache = {}
    @cache_mutex = Mutex.new
  end

  def verify_token(token, service_id)
    parts = token.split('.')
    return false unless parts.length == 3

    header_b64, payload_b64, signature_b64 = parts

    begin
      header_json = Base64.urlsafe_decode64(header_b64)
      header = JSON.parse(header_json)
      payload_json = Base64.urlsafe_decode64(payload_b64)
      payload = JSON.parse(payload_json)
    rescue ArgumentError, JSON::ParserError
      return false
    end

    # Validate the declared algorithm to prevent algorithm confusion.
    return false unless header.is_a?(Hash) && header['alg'] == EXPECTED_ALG
    return false unless payload.is_a?(Hash)

    return false unless payload['service_id'] == service_id
    return false unless payload['exp'].to_i > Time.now.to_i

    nonce = payload['nonce']
    return false unless nonce.is_a?(String) && !nonce.empty?

    @cache_mutex.synchronize do
      prune_expired_nonces
      return false if @nonce_cache[nonce]
      @nonce_cache[nonce] = payload['exp'].to_i
    end

    expected_sig = compute_signature(header_b64, payload_b64)
    secure_compare(expected_sig, signature_b64)
  end

  private

  def prune_expired_nonces
    now = Time.now.to_i
    @nonce_cache.delete_if { |_nonce, exp| exp <= now }
  end

  def compute_signature(header_b64, payload_b64)
    data = "#{header_b64}.#{payload_b64}"
    hmac = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest(HMAC_ALGORITHM, @shared_secret, data)
    Base64.urlsafe_encode64(hmac, padding: false)
  end

  def secure_compare(a, b)
    return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
    result = 0
    a.bytes.zip(b.bytes) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
    result == 0
  end
end

class InferenceServer < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :auth_secret, ENV.fetch('AUTH_SECRET', SecureRandom.hex(32))
    set :verifier, AuthTokenVerifier.new(settings.auth_secret)
    set :max_input_size, 4096
    set :output_buffer_size, 8192
  end

  before do
    content_type :json
  end

  post '/predict' do
    auth_header = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']
    halt 401, { error: 'Missing authorization' }.to_json unless auth_header

    token = auth_header.sub(/^Bearer\s+/, '')
    service_id = request.env['HTTP_X_SERVICE_ID']
    halt 401, { error: 'Missing service ID' }.to_json unless service_id

    unless settings.verifier.verify_token(token, service_id)
      halt 403, { error: 'Invalid token' }.to_json
    end

    begin
      body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      halt 400, { error: 'Invalid JSON' }.to_json
    end

    input_data = body['input']
    halt 400, { error: 'Missing input' }.to_json unless input_data

    result = run_inference(input_data)
    { prediction: result }.to_json
  end

  private

  def run_inference(input_data)
    serialized = input_data.is_a?(Array) ? input_data.pack('f*') : input_data.to_s

    if serialized.bytesize > settings.max_input_size
      halt 400, { error: 'Input too large' }.to_json
    end

    output_size = settings.output_buffer_size
    output_buffer = Fiddle::Pointer.malloc(output_size)

    input_ptr = Fiddle::Pointer[serialized]

    ret = NativeInference.predict(
      input_ptr,
      serialized.bytesize,
      output_buffer,
      output_size
    )

    if ret < 0
      halt 500, { error: 'Inference failed' }.to_json
    end

    if ret > output_size
      halt 500, { error: 'Inference output overflow' }.to_json
    end

    output_buffer[0, ret].unpack('f*')
  end
end

InferenceServer.run! if __FILE__ == $0
